description: Activate when: our KPI is going up but the real outcome isn't improving; people seem to be gaming the metric; we're about to tie bonuses or promotions to a number; an algorithm is producing results nobody intended; a test or audit system is being designed. Do NOT activate when: the metric IS the goal with no proxy gap; measurement is purely descriptive with zero stakes attached. More: deciqai.com/c/goodharts-law

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
